translations.web: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.
translations.bsb: He who isolates himself pursues selfish desires; he rebels against all sound judgment.
translations.kjv: Through desire a man, having separated himself, seeketh and intermeddleth with all wisdom.
translations.asv: He that separateth himself seeketh his own desire, And rageth against all sound wisdom.
